facebook.caption:
9,825 people rated this place. Most tourists on the island have no idea it exists.

Phu Quoc Prison History Museum sits at 350 Đ. Nguyễn Văn Cừ. French colonial prison. Vietnam War POWs. Mannequins showing exactly what happened inside these walls.

Not comfortable. Not supposed to be. But if you want to understand Phu Quoc beyond the beach, this is 2 hours that will stay with you.

4.3 stars. Go. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
